name: ferry
caption: A ferry with a wide hull, two decks and a loading opening. A flat hull carries a deck and a cabin; square ends close the shell. Faceted hull panels keep a constant thickness along the keel. Overall width is 2.60 times depth; height is 0.75 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous red, cream, charcoal color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
